prompt: Create a standalone decorative website footer asset for a Chinese knowledge atlas, wide horizontal 3:1 composition. Warm off-white handmade paper background, bottom third consists of layered torn-paper mountains, muted sage-grey printed contours and tiny abstract typographic fragments with no readable text. Fine amber network thread with three tiny dots subtly crossing the lower mountain layers. Top half quiet off-white paper and feathered paper edges blending into ivory #f8f6f1. Sophisticated editorial collage, fine tactile texture, understated and light. No UI, no words, no icons, no buttons, no mockup, no strong dark peaks. This is an independent reusable background asset, not the whole page.
